response.sql: WITH execution_counts AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) as execution_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), total_executions AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM orderexecutions), shares_with_avg AS (SELECT ec.ordersmark, ec.execution_count, CAST(ec.execution_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(te.total AS NUMERIC) as share, AVG(CAST(ec.execution_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(te.total AS NUMERIC)) OVER () as avg_share FROM execution_counts ec CROSS JOIN total_executions te) SELECT ordersmark, execution_count, share, share - avg_share as difference FROM shares_with_avg ORDER BY ordersmark IS NULL ASC, difference DESC LIMIT 10
